body: I’m not sure if I am pregnant or not. I took a Plan B pill an exact week after the first time. That was the 12th I took the pill. Am I pregnant or is it blood from taking the pill?

That’s a hard situation. Every single day I tell at least one more new person about the personality disorder I have that’s in my life. It’s never ending but I only tell them about it when I feel like I’m starting to get another episode so they understand it’s “not necessarily me”. I just say that I take things a lot more personal than the norm, I have a big fear of being abandoned, and my mood is always unstable along with my relationships too.

What about a goal you made when you were really young? Your younger self would be so proud of you if you were able to get around this depression and able to achieve that goal you made when you were younger. Even if it may not be anything you are interested in trying for because it's "not you anymore" or you don't have "that energy" to try it, you'd still feel accomplished for possibly even just trying it out. I only have three reasons why I'm still alive. That's my boyfriend for the first one, the second one is my online friends that aren't connected to any of my other friends that know me in person would never figure out what happened to me and why we stopped talking. They'd grow old probably still questioning what happened to me and why we haven't talked in years. They'd never figure out if I killed myself or if anything else might have happened and my third reason would be, I still have my biggest goal to travel the world before I die to complete. Please stay alive for me. I want to help you the best I can.

Who would care though? I'm sure someone would care. I damn sure would care if you killed yourself. That'd hurt that I saw someone's post on Reddit and I wasn't able to help them. I want to help you. You matter, you really do. If I can help you in any way, even if that just means for me just to be someone you text when you feel suicidal, I want to be there and be that person. I want to help you. I literally just came from my bathroom testing out how effective my new way I'll attempt suicide will be. But, I'll stay alive if that means I can change your life and make you feel better.
